# Android 1.0.0 dependency source and notice inventory

The following exact source archives are included under `sources/` and checked against `android-source-manifest.json` before builds and packaging:

| Component | Archive | Android linkage/build |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GMP 6.3.0 | `gmp-6.3.0.tar.xz` | Static PIC, ARM64 assembly retained |
| MPFR 4.2.2 | `mpfr-4.2.2.tar.xz` | Static PIC, linked to GMP |
| libqalculate 5.12.0 | `libqalculate-5.12.0.tar.gz` | Static PIC, compiled offline definitions, bundled Bionic patch |
| libxml2 2.15.4 | `libxml2-2.15.4.tar.xz` | Static PIC, no Python/ICU/iconv extras |
| OpenSSL 3.5.9 | `openssl-3.5.9.tar.gz` | Shared `libcrypto_3.so` / `libssl_3.so`, runtime-loaded by Qt Network |
| Qt Base 6.10.3 | `qtbase-everywhere-src-6.10.3.tar.xz` | Shared Core/Gui/Widgets/Network and deployment-selected plugins, rebuilt for 16 KiB |

The libqalculate adaptation is `patches/libqalculate-5.12.0-android-thread-cancel.patch`. Its exact patch bytes, `android/openssl-qt.conf`, and `scripts/android-dependencies.sh`, `android-rebuild-qt.sh`, `android-relink-libcxx.sh`, `android-verify-libcxx.py` and deployment script define the Android changes/build flags. Qt target source is rebuilt; the downloaded binary Qt kit supplies matching host tools rather than the final shared target libraries.

NDK r27c's original PIC libc++/libc++abi objects are relinked with both maximum/common page-size flags. Their hashes and the official NDK distribution hash are pinned and ABI-checked. Runtime licensing is preserved in `licenses/Android-NDK-r27c-NOTICE*.txt`; the full pinned compiler/toolchain download is separate from this application source package.

`android-java-dependencies.json` lists resolved AndroidX and transitive Java components, POM/source URLs, upstream declared licenses and digest evidence. `licenses/android-java/` contains their POM metadata, the inherited Guava parent POM and embedded notice copies. Exact upstream Java/Kotlin source classifiers for all 22 runtime components are bundled in `sources-java/` and pinned by `android-java-source-manifest.json`, including upstream HTTPS checksum provenance. These are source-only JAR containers with no compiled classes/native libraries; the source packager validates each manifest hash and rejects compiled content, unsafe paths, links and duplicate entries. Gradle still obtains the compiled AAR/JAR runtime artifacts, which are excluded from the source package. The runtime-classpath inventory records the same 22 coordinates/versions and binary hashes.

`android-qtbase-sbom.spdx` is generated by the actual Qt build and includes bundled third-party component/license information as well as build-only/full-kit entries. Exact per-file SPDX and copyright notices remain in the unchanged Qt source archive. `licenses/native/` adds readable standalone license texts. Source Sans 3 font assets, when used by the documentation, retain their OFL copyright/license alongside the font files.

Read `../docs/BUILD-ANDROID.md`, `../docs/CORRESPONDING-SOURCE.md` and `../THIRD-PARTY.md`. Private signing material and personal calculator data do not belong anywhere in the source tree.
